newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Heavy may join Rolls-Royce engine project.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Heavy may join Rolls-Royce engine project.

text.p: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd said on Thursday it is considering taking part in Rolls-Royce Plc's Trent aircraft engine development project.
A spokesman for Kawasaki Heavy said Rolls-Royce had asked it earlier this year to take part in the development of a new Trent 900 aircraft engine.
In the project, Rolls-Royce plans to develop a new engine with a thrust of 80,000 pounds by improving its Trent 800 engine.
The total cost of the project will likely be about 30 billion yen, the spokesman said.
Kawasaki was a partner in the development of the Trent 800, he said.
